description: Add a kanban column (swimlane) to a 'todo' board. Generates and returns a stable column id. `sort` is a float ordering key (ascending); omit to default to 0. `lane` is an integer row index for multi-row layouts (defaults to 0). `color` is an optional title color ('red' / 'blue' / 'green', or 'auto' / omit for default). To rename, reorder, recolor or move between lanes later use `update_column`.

access_key.description: Board key for direct MCP clients that handle credentials outside chat. Accepts an 8-character key or a legacy 6-character key. Keep the key out of chat and use the browser or an MCP client configured with the X-Board-Key header.

lane.description: Row index for multi-row layouts. Defaults to 0.

name: create_column
title: Create Column
